3	# ECC Curator
4	
5	> **Context governance for long-running local coding agents.**
6	
7	Long-running coding sessions accumulate plans, logs, tool output, test results, diffs, memories, and conversation history. Carrying all of it forward can fill a finite context window, bury useful evidence, and put pressure on constrained hardware. A 64K or 128K window is still a budget—not an instruction to retain everything.
8	
9	ECC Curator is a design-stage governance layer for deciding what context should reach the next model call. It treats session context as a budgeted working set and selects an action for each item:
10	
11	```text
12	Governance
13	    ↓
14	Keep
15	Compress
16	Transform
17	Drop
18	```
19	
20	**Compression is a strategy. Governance is the decision.** A shorter version of irrelevant material is still irrelevant; important information may need to be kept unchanged or transformed into a more useful form. ECC Curator is intended to govern accumulated context before it is assembled for the next step, with task outcomes—not token reduction alone—as the measure of success.
